entries.finding: Nested-LORO cross-fitted mean CRE20 did not improve on exact u4.
entries.next_discriminator: Test the single strongest bounded residual on a source-disjoint family without KIFMS retuning.

entries.finding: Nested-LORO cross-fitted relative WSS95 was negative.
entries.next_discriminator: Retain WSS95 as noncompensatory; no CRE20 gain may pay for extra screening work.

entries.finding: Worst held-out R@10 harm was far below the unchanged -0.05 floor.
entries.next_discriminator: Require source-disjoint worst-review harm and retain exact u4 fallback.

entries.finding: The selector fell back to exact u4 in twelve of fourteen folds; both nonfallback selections were adverse on their held-out review.
entries.next_discriminator: Treat exclusion-sensitive support as a target, not as positive selection evidence.

entries.finding: None of the six configurations passed CRE20, WSS95, and worst-review R@10 support jointly over all fourteen development reviews.
entries.next_discriminator: Carry only the most scientifically informative title-emphasis configuration as a diagnostic into a source-disjoint family.

entries.finding: KIFMS is open same-workspace development data and cannot provide confirmation or independent custody.
entries.next_discriminator: Acquire and freeze a lawful source-disjoint family before its labels or comparative outcomes are opened.
